editorial.description_en: Shallow water over a pale bed — blue enough to name, with the green of the shallows still in it.
editorial.description_ja: 浅い水のような、緑みをのこしたうすい青。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.893, C 0.030, h 226.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 薄 (usu, thin) + 水 (mizu, water). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Thin Water" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 薄水. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — hatsu-gori at ΔE00 4.1, asa-kawa at ΔE00 4.7, usu-rai at ΔE00 5.1. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.030 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
